title: Vue.ai pricing - Custom subscription, not publicly disclosed
clean_text: Vue.ai does not publish pricing on its website or major review platforms such as G2 or TrustRadius, requiring direct sales contact for a quote. The platform uses a subscription-based pricing model structured according to which specific modules and features a customer selects, such as catalog automation, personalization, or visual search. Vue.ai raised $50 million in funding from Taj Investment Holdings in September 2024, following a $17 million Series B led by Sequoia Capital India in 2019, bringing total known funding to approximately $77.5 million.
